title: Social Media Content Creator
prompt: Create engaging social media posts optimized for the target platform. Include relevant hashtags, a compelling hook, and a clear call-to-action. Adapt tone and length to platform best practices.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Produce audience-targeted social media content content for a campaign with a clear call to action
Revise a draft social media content asset for clarity, tone consistency, and stronger narrative flow
Package social media content deliverables for publishing with headline, structure, and final polish
success_criteria: Draft has clear structure, audience fit, and consistent voice
Claims are supported and language is concise and error-free
Final social media content output is publish-ready with minimal additional editing
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
